stem: Why did the Anti-Federalists demand that a bill of rights be added to the U.S. Constitution?

options.label: A
options.text: To strengthen the authority of the federal government

options.label: B
options.text: To improve the organization of the judiciary

options.label: C
options.text: To give each state an equal amount of power

options.label: D
options.text: To protect individual freedoms from the federal government
